about_the_game:
Tear into an action packed dinosaur arena brawler where you engage in non-stop life or death fights that will push your abilities to their limits. King of Bones delivers physics-driven skill-based combat that carries the full weight and impact of prehistoric creatures. Dash, dodge, stomp, headbutt, and smash your way through multiple game modes and over two dozen unique species as you battle to become king of the Jurassic world.

PHYSICS DRIVEN COMBAT

Vicious raptors will pounce and cling to your body. A charging triceratops can send you flying. Every part of the fighting system was designed to replicate the look and feel of these deadly titans clashing. Fights will be fast-paced and messy, enemies will struggle till the very end.

MULTIPLE GAME MODES

Survive free-for-all deathmatches in King of the Hill. Hatch from an egg and fight every dinosaur in the game while growing into a towering giant in Ascension. Fight non stop waves with ever increasing numbers in Onslaught. Or setup custom fights and sit back and watch the action in the Spectator mode.

WEAPONS AND ENVIRONMENTAL DANGERS

Grab a nearby log or bone to wield against your foe. Get blasted through the air by a high powered geyser hidden beneath the foggy waters. Or use your last kill's tail to bash your next kill. King of Bones will let you engage in all sorts of crazy carnage you've only ever imagined.

SPECTATOR AND PHOTOGRAPHY MODE

Dishing out the damage not really your thing? Setup teams with dinosaurs of your choosing and watch AI battle it out while you spectate the action. Take photos, control the speed of time, and get a front row seat on the carnage.

INCREDIBLE ATTENTION TO DETAIL

Subtle breathing of your dinosaur, dynamic stances, real-time body controls, detailed animations and so much more breathe unbelievable life into the dinosaurs. Leaves move beneath your feet and blow to the wind with a mighty roar. The small details are what makes this an experience like no other.

EXOTIC SPECIES

With 27 unique species, the arena will challenge you in different ways as each species has their own fighting style. Get crushed by an Ankylosaur's tail swings. Send dinosaurs flying with the Pachycephalosaur's headbutt. Every dinosaur is dangerous in its own way.

REALTIME PHYSICALLY SIMULATED BODIES

Using the latest Unreal Engine tools the dinosaurs' physical bodies are constantly simulated in the world which means every bite, headbutt, and stomp interact properly with each other.

GORE AND DISMEMBERMENT

Rip the flesh of your prey to shreds and consume every last bit of them. Fully dismemberable and simulated bodies mean you can make the most of your meal. The scars and wounds of battle and each bite taken out of you will all be readily visible.

King of Bones is a bold attempt at pushing forward the combat mechanics in the dinosaur simulation genre. Expect non-stop high impact straight up fights for your life. In this prehistoric world... death finds a way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 980 or equivalent with 4GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 1080 or equivalent with 8GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
